Anna thinks art is interesting but a little difficult. Anna is going to travel to Rome in September. Last Tuesday, Anna and Max went to the city square. They enjoy quiet weekends in the countryside.
There are always many people at the corner store. It takes twenty minutes to get to the city square by bike. Both of them like dumplings and water. Best of all, the bus was full of tourists.
The weather was cloudy that day. Anna and Max had great fun there. Anna is reading a book about art. Shipping takes three to five days.
Anna borrowed a book about art from the bookstore. Anna wrote about the day in the diary. Life is full of small surprises.
